newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse closes up 1 pct in choppy water.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse closes up 1 pct in choppy water.

text.p: 1535 GMT - Brussels Bel-20 share index closed on a higher note ahead of Easter holiday, with electronicS group Barco leading the index higher.
* Bel-20 .BFX closed up 1.03 percent at 2,146.37, with modest 3 billion francs volume of Belgian shares traded.
* Barco rallied to end up 5.87 percent at 5,950 francs, helped by strong 1996 earnings and 1997 profit forecast.
* Steel cord and wire maker Bekaert second largest Bel-20 gainer, up 5.05 percent at 22,350 francs, but with thin volume traded.
